headline: Bank of Jamaica Allots JMD 30 Billion in 30-Day Certificate of Deposit
summary: The Bank of Jamaica allocated JMD 30,000,000,000.00 in fixed-rate 6.75% certificates of deposit maturing in 2026 through a competitive price auction.
why: Central bank certificate of deposit auctions are primary monetary policy instruments used to manage domestic liquidity and short-term interest rates.

impacts.name: Jamaica
impacts.why: Central bank debt auctions directly affect domestic money market liquidity and local borrowing rates.
